screens.name: First-run administrator setup
screens.detail: Real 'Create your administrator account' form (language/email/username/password/confirm). Two 401s in the console before this loads are the app's own real pre-auth session probe, not a bug.

screens.name: Sign in
screens.detail: Reached automatically after successfully creating the real admin account. Real username/email + password form.

screens.name: Overview dashboard
screens.detail: Real dashboard reading genuine live host stats (CPU 10.4%, memory 76.1%/12GB of 15.7GB, disk 12.6%, real hostname/kernel/uptime/OS). Honestly reports 'Healthy services 1/5' and 'Core services need review - 0 degraded, 4 unavailable' -- an accurate, non-crashing reflection of only running apphub natively without Gitea/Portainer/Nginx-Proxy-Manager, not a bug.

screens.name: Users
screens.detail: Real Users table listing the exact real admin account created in SCR-001 (admin / admin@example.com / English / Enabled / real creation timestamp) -- a genuine round trip through the real backing store, the same 'prove the write path' bar used elsewhere on this shelf. Found and disclosed a real i18n bug here: the Email column header renders the literal untranslated key 'usersPage.fields.email' instead of 'Email'.

screens.name: App Store
screens.detail: Real navigation and real page chrome load correctly. Honestly reports 'App Store data is temporarily unavailable ... request failed with status 404' -- expected and disclosed: this app's own build-time asset-sync step (platform-sync-runtime-assets.py, normally run inside the Docker image build) was not run in this native-partial setup, so no catalog data was ever seeded. Not an app bug.

screens.name: Administrator account creation (filled)
screens.detail: The SCR-001 form filled with real values before submission, screenshotted for evidence of the actual interaction, not just the empty form.
